sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Capacity Management helps Cost Centre Owners manage team utilization and respond to resource requests, and gives Controllers / Executives an organization-wide capacity rollup. It has two main tabs: **My Team** (your cost centre's heatmap) and **Organization Overview** (cross-CC comparison). A **Resource Requests** sub-view (`/capacity/requests`) handles incoming resource confirmations and project intakes, with a per-project assignment grid at `/capacity/project-assignment/<project-id>`.

sections.title: My Team Tab
sections.body: Shows your cost centre's utilization as a heatmap grid. Rows are people grouped by role, columns are months. Each cell is color-coded by utilization percentage. A summary bar at the top shows team-level metrics: average utilization, headcount, over/under-allocated count, and pending request count.

sections.title: Heatmap Colors
sections.body: **Blue** (below 70%): Under-utilized — person has available capacity. **Green** (70-90%): Healthy utilization range. **Amber** (90-100%): Near capacity — limited availability. **Red** (above 100%): Over-allocated — needs immediate attention. Cell backgrounds use reduced opacity with the color as accent.

sections.title: Person Detail Drawer
sections.body: Click any person row or cell to open a bottom drawer showing their full allocation breakdown: which projects they're assigned to, hours per month, confirmed vs pending allocations, and utilization trend over time.

sections.title: Project Confirmation View
sections.body:
When projects are submitted (intake) or CRs are routed to your CC, they appear at `/capacity/requests` as a list of cards. Each card shows the parent name (project or CR), organizational entity, project lead, timeline, and number of resource requests. The page header reads 'X Items awaiting resource confirmation'. Each card has:
- **Review & Assign Resources** — opens the per-project assignment grid (see next section)
- **Decline** — present on intake-driven cards (project submissions) but not on CR-only cards. Opens a reason modal; declining sends the project / CR back to the Project Lead.

CR-only cards (those with '0 resource requests') are CRs that don't change resource hours but still need CC sign-off because they touch the CC's budget (e.g., AWS scaling cost added to a project under your CC). Click **Review & Assign Resources** to inspect and confirm.

sections.title: Resource Assignment Grid
sections.body: The dedicated assignment page (`/capacity/project-assignment/<project-id>`) shows a tabular grid for all internal resource requests. Rows represent requested roles (e.g., Senior Developer, QA / Test Engineer), columns represent months with collapsible year headers. Each cell shows the requested hours for that role × month. Click any cell to open a person dropdown and assign an employee for that specific month. Assigned cells turn green with the person's abbreviated name; unassigned cells appear in amber. A Status column on the right shows how many months are assigned per role (e.g., 12/19).

sections.title: Assign All Column
sections.body: The **All** column (between the role name and the month columns) lets you assign one person to every month of a role in a single click. Click the All cell, select an employee from the dropdown, and all months fill instantly. When all months have the same person, the All cell shows their name in blue. You can still override individual months by clicking specific cells. External cost requests are not shown on this page since they do not require employee assignment.

sections.title: Person Dropdown
sections.body: When selecting an employee, the dropdown groups people by relevance: **Matching Role** employees appear first (those whose role matches the requested role), followed by **Other Roles**. For individual month cells, each person shows their utilization percentage for that specific month, color-coded: green (below 70%), amber (70-90%), or red (above 90%). Only one employee per month per request is allowed. The All-cell dropdown shows row-aggregated utilization across all the row's months.

sections.title: Confirming Resources
sections.body:
Once all resource requests for a project / CR have complete assignments (all months covered), the **Confirm All & Send to Controller** button becomes active. Clicking it confirms all requests, creates `Allocation` records for each assigned employee, and:
- For project intakes: moves the project to the controller's intake queue for final approval. The assigned employee names will be visible to the controller in the intake detail view.
- For CR-linked requests: moves the parent CR to `pending_controller_approval`.

For CR-only items (no resource requests), the same button just confirms the CR's cost-only impact and routes it onward.

sections.title: Resource Requests Sub-view
sections.body: The Resource Requests sub-view (`/capacity/requests`, accessible via the **Resource Requests** button on the My Team tab) shows incoming resource confirmation items directed at your cost centre: a mix of project intakes and CR-linked requests. Each item is grouped by parent project / CR. Items with explicit resource changes show their delta context; items that are CR-only (cost adjustments) appear with '0 resource requests' but still require sign-off.

sections.title: Per-Request Actions
sections.body:
Inside the per-project assignment grid (or in the per-request side drawer), each individual resource request supports four actions: **Confirm** (accept as-is, assigning a named person), **Partially Fulfill** (adjust hours, amount, or period — routes back to PL for sign-off), **Counter-Propose** (offer an alternative such as a different person, role, or split — routes back to PL for negotiation), or **Decline** (with required reason — routes back to PL).

**Delta-Based Resource Requests:** Resource requests from CRs show the change delta rather than absolute hours. Each request displays: the change direction (Increase or Decrease badge), the delta hours (e.g. +15h or -20h), the original allocation before the change, the resulting total after the change, and who is currently allocated to that role. For increases, confirming adds hours to the person's allocation. For decreases, confirming reduces the existing person's allocation rather than creating a new one.

**CR-Linked Requests:** Some resource requests are linked to change requests. When you confirm a CR-linked request, the associated CR is automatically advanced. If you decline, the CR is sent back to the Project Lead. This is the final stage of the CR workflow — the CC Owner confirmation completes the approval process. The full per-action walks are in `docs/workflows/05-resource-requests.md` (W05.1-W05.4).

sections.title: Organization Overview Tab
sections.body: Shows utilization across all cost centres in a single heatmap. Supports three pivot dimensions: by the active portfolio hierarchy level (e.g., Line of Business if that is the configured hierarchy), by Role, and by Cost Centre. Pivot labels adapt dynamically to the active hierarchy configuration set in Administration. Click any cell or row to open a bottom drawer showing project-level consumption detail for that dimension.
